blocks.html: Robinsons Malls through The Gift of Change recently provided assistance to the evacuees in Iligan City by mobilizing relief operations to help the victims and their families who were displaced by the crisis. The Iligan-based team of Robinsons Malls went out of their way to visit several evacuation centers in Iligan City . These evacuation centers are located in Brgy. Sta. Elena and Brgy. Buru-un where over 250 families are currently residing. Relief goods were also distributed to families currently housed in the Regional Command and Coordination Center. Recipients received relief packs containing basic food items such as canned goods, biscuits and noodles which became an opportunity for the residents to gradually recover from the pains and losses they experienced caused by the ongoing conflict in the province. The Gift of Change program is part of Robinsons Malls’ corporate social responsibility program focused on Community Development, Health and Wellness programs for the less fortunate Filipino. Its’ current projects include The Gift of Sight, Libreng Bakuna, Bike for Change, & Relief Operations.
